**[P2] Preserve earlier invocation boundaries in terminal roots**

This end time uses only the current invocation's fresh wall anchor, while reset discards the preceding boundary. If wall time moves backward before a resume, terminal `Workflow` and `DurableExecutionRoot` spans can end before an already-exported earlier `Invocation`, or even before their supplied execution start. Preserve a per-execution high-water timestamp across resets and clamp terminal root ends to it; add a pending/resumed same-plugin rollback test.
